compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is a "Settings" page for an application. The main contents and functions are as follows:

1. **Application Settings:**
   - **Auto-Refreshing:** Set to refresh every 30 seconds.
   - **Article Text Size:** Set to small.

2. **Account:**
   - Status shows "Not Logged In" with an option to log in.

3. **Notifications:**
   - **Enable Notifications:** Toggle switch to turn notifications on or off.
   - **Team News:** Toggle switch to receive notifications about team news.
   - **Start of Game:** Toggle switch to receive notifications at the start of a game.
   - **End of Quarter:** Toggle switch to receive notifications at the end of each quarter.
   - **End of Game:** Toggle switch to receive notifications at the end of a game.
